# module: shfmt
# case:   both
# vars:
#   EXTRA_ARGS=BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
#   SHFMT_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN=BASE-SHFMT_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   SHFMT_VERSION=BASE-SHFMT_VERSION
#   TARGETS=BASE-TARGETS
#   EXTRA_ARGS_OVERRIDE=OVR-EXTRA_ARGS
#   SHFMT_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN_OVERRIDE=OVR-SHFMT_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   SHFMT_VERSION_OVERRIDE=OVR-SHFMT_VERSION
#   TARGETS_OVERRIDE=OVR-TARGETS

=== task: fmt ===

    "OVR-TARGETS"
    OVR-EXTRA_ARGS \
    gopath=\"$(go env GOPATH)\"
  "$HOME/go/bin/shfmt" -w \
  OVR-EXTRA_ARGS <"$file_list"
  echo 'No matching shell scripts found'
  exit
  exit 0
  fi
  filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" >"$file_list"
  find "$target" -type f \( -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.bash' \) -print0
  gobin=\"$(go env GOBIN)\"
  gobin=\"${gopath:-$HOME/go}/bin\"
  gopath=\"${GOPATH:-}\"
  if [ -z \"$gopath\" ] && command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\000' "$target"
" result: "$HOME/go/bin"
elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
fi
fi
fi
fi
fi | task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/shfmt/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
file_list="$(mktemp)"
if [ ! -s "$file_list" ]; then
if [ -d "$target" ]; then
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
if [ -z \"$gobin\" ] && command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
if [ -z \"$gobin\" ]; then
printf '%s' \"$gobin\"
target='OVR-TARGETS'
task: "_fmt:unix" finished
task: "_fmt:unix" started
task: "_fmt:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:unix" finished
task: "_install:unix" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "fmt" finished
task: "fmt" started
task: "go:_install:linux:tarball" not for current platform - ignored
task: "go:_install:macos:brew" started
task: "go:_install:macos:pkg" started
task: "go:_install:windows:msi" not for current platform - ignored
task: "go:_shell:setup:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "go:install" finished
task: "go:install" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: Task "go:_install:macos:brew" is up to date
task: Task "go:_install:macos:pkg" is up to date
task: [_fmt:unix] skip_pattern='OVR-SHFMT_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN'
task: [_install:unix] GOBIN="$HOME/go/bin" go install mvdan.cc/sh/v3/cmd/shfmt@BASE-SHFMT_VERSION
task: dynamic variable: "gobin=\"${GOBIN:-}\"
task: dynamic variable: "uname -m" result: "arm64"
task: status command [ "false" != "true" ] exited zero
task: status command [ -n "" ] || command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 exited zero
task: status command [ -z "" ] || { [ "false" != "true" ] && test -x "/usr/local/go/bin/go" && [ "$("/usr/local/go/bin/go" version | awk '{print $3}')" = "" ]; } exited zero
task: status command test -x "$HOME/go/bin/shfmt" exited non-zero: exit status 1
trap 'rm -f "$file_list"' EXIT
xargs -0 "$HOME/go/bin/shfmt" -w \
